Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
Northwind Financial - Bengaluru (Hybrid)

About the role
You will own the services that move money for millions of customers. This is a
hands-on senior role on a team of eight engineers.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and operate distributed backend services handling high transaction volume.
- Own reliability for payment-critical systems, including on-call and incident response.
- Partner with finance and product to turn reconciliation requirements into services.
- Raise engineering standards through code review and mentoring.

Required Qualifications
- 6+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Deep expertise in Python and strong SQL skills, with production PostgreSQL experience.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production.
- Experience designing event-driven systems with Kafka or an equivalent message queue.
- Demonstrated ownership of system design for high-availability services on AWS.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Go or Rust for performance-critical services.
- Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure as code.
- Background in payments, settlement or financial reconciliation.
- Exposure to observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.

Benefits
Competitive salary, equity, private health cover and an annual learning budget.
Northwind Financial is an equal opportunity employer.
